annotations.title: Export a clip in other shapes or quality

description:
Use this when the user wants a clip in another shape or quality: "make a square version", "export it in 4K",
"one for each platform". Each shape renders as a new Library clip; the original stays. Free plan: watermark,
and several shapes, 1440 and 2160 are Premium. Returns a job_id per shape.
Not for: changing the look (style_clip) or many clips in one file (download_all_clips). Free: no Horizon
Units.

clip_id.description: Clip id from list_clips. A saved photo is refused.

fps.description: Frame rate: 24, 25, 30, 50 or 60. 0 keeps the clip's own.

resolution.description: Short side in pixels: 720, 1080, 1440 or 2160 (4K). Empty keeps the clip's own.

shapes.description: Output shapes, up to 4 per call: any of 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9, 4:3, 3:4, 2:3, 21:9. Empty keeps the clip's own shape.
